evaluation.summary: A single discover-page signal indicates active pt-BR TikTok interest in music framed around anxiety relief, and the consumption context (quick calming audio during anxious moments) fits TikTok's short-form search behavior well. However, no existing playlist matches this niche, evidence is limited to one MEDIUM-confidence observation, and there is no data on trend growth, competitors, or streaming outcomes. The opportunity looks directionally promising but remains under-validated.
